platform.description: Post-rebrand Windows-checkout source contracts, rolled forward for issue #133 named layouts after auditing the single changed hunk. The only change to the session artifact is the parse-site .allocate = .alloc_always string-ownership fix, written byte-identically to the same fix on the #158 and #163 branches so a later merge yields one copy instead of a duplicate struct field initializer. The on-disk schema is unchanged at v1. Hashes reflect checkout normalization. This git_commit exists only on the PR branch: after a squash-merge it becomes unreachable and Test-VerificationContracts.ps1 skips the git-diff cross-check while the sha256 check still runs, so re-point it at the merge commit on main (see RECONCILE-SESSION-STATE.md).
